class.name: SteamController
class.brief_description: Represents one live connection through Steam Input.
class.description: Get a view from [method SteamInput.controllers] or a controller signal. A controller view becomes unavailable when its lease ends or the hardware disconnects. Steam supplies the action sets, layers, and state. The game owns player assignment and maps input values to local gameplay commands. Call on the main thread.

method.name: activate_layer
method.description: Asks Steam to apply the named [param name] layer to the current set. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if the published name is unknown, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is empty or exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes, or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when this view or native capability is unavailable.

method.name: analog
method.description: Reads [param action] in the current Steam Input frame. Inactive input returns an inactive zero vector. Unknown actions return [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. An empty or oversized action name returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A retired view or unavailable Steam interface returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: deactivate_layer
method.description: Asks Steam to remove the named [param name] layer from the current set. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if the published name is unknown, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is empty or exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes, or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when this view or native capability is unavailable.

method.name: digital
method.description: Reads [param action] in the current Steam Input frame. An inactive action reports [code]active = false[/code]. Unknown actions return [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST]. An empty or oversized action name returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A retired view or unavailable Steam interface returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE].

method.name: glyph
method.description: Returns a PNG texture at [param size] for the first effective Steam binding origin of [param action]. An unbound action, unavailable glyph, or retired view returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. An invalid size or action name returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: glyphs
method.description: Returns the textures at [param size] for the effective Steam binding origins of [param action] in origin order. The highest active layer that supplies origins takes precedence over the base set. An unbound action, unavailable glyph, or retired view returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. An invalid size or action name returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: is_connected
method.description: Returns whether this view still identifies the same live connection in its owning lease.

method.name: open_binding_panel
method.description: Requests Steam's binding configuration panel for this controller. [constant OK] acknowledges the request. Returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] if Steam declines or the controller is disconnected.

method.name: type
method.description: Returns Steam's controller family. Returns [constant TYPE_UNKNOWN] if the view is unavailable or the reported value is unrecognized.

method.name: use_action_set
method.description: Asks Steam to select the [param name] action set from the manifest. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if the published name is unknown, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if it is empty or exceeds 128 UTF-8 bytes, or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when this view or native capability is unavailable.

method.name: vibrate
method.description: Submits normalized [param low] and [param high] motor amplitudes from 0 to 1. Pass zero for both to clear the request. [constant OK] acknowledges the SDK submission. A disconnected controller or missing vibration capability returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. Nonfinite or out-of-range values return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

constants.constant: Steam did not identify a supported controller family.
